profile.businessType: The company operates in mining service business, with current operations in open-pit mining including Mine Planning and Logistics, Open-pit Mining Operations, Mining Consultancy and Heavy-duty Machine Leasing, Rental and Maintenance. The company's current projects are  Mae Moh 8 and Hongsa project.
